# Module: factor

## Purpose

Defines residual/Jacobian models evaluated in GPU batches.

## Core interfaces

- `factor_batch.h`: abstract `FactorBatch`
- `sized_factor_batch.h`: compile-time dimension helper `SizedFactorBatch`

## Built-in factor families

Per-manifold implementations live in kind-named subfolders; each also has a
manifold-generic, compile-time-deduced facade:

- `between/`: relative-pose factors (`so2/so3/se2/se3/similarity2/similarity3/sl4/vector_between_factor_batch.h`)
  plus the facade `between/between_factor_batch.h` (`BetweenFactorBatch<Manifold>`,
  manifold deduced from the deltas pointer's type — no `<Manifold>` needed).
- `prior/`: prior factors (`so2/so3/se2/se3/similarity2/similarity3/sl4/prior_vector_factor_batch.h`)
  plus the facade `prior/prior_factor_batch.h` (`PriorFactorBatch<Manifold>`, same deduction).
- `motion/`: constant-velocity/-acceleration motion-prior factors
  (`constant_velocity_so2/so3/se2/se3_factor_batch.h`,
  `constant_acceleration_so2/so3/se2/se3_factor_batch.h`) plus the facades
  `motion/constant_velocity_factor_batch.h`/`constant_acceleration_factor_batch.h`
  (`ConstantVelocityFactorBatch<Manifold>`/`ConstantAccelerationFactorBatch<Manifold>` —
  manifold is an explicit template argument, not deduced).
- `information/`: covariance/weight fusion — `information/information_factor_batch.h`
  (generic `InformationFactorBatch<T>` wrapper) and
  `information/motion_prior_information.h` (closed-form `Q(dt)^-1` for the
  `motion/` factors, plus `MotionPriorInformationFactorBatch<T, Dim>`).
- Reprojection: `reprojection_factor_batch.h`
- PnP (fixed 3D points, pose-only Jacobian): `pnp_factor_batch.h`
- Registration: `point_to_point_factor_batch.h`, `point_to_plane_factor_batch.h`,
  `symmetric_point_to_plane_factor_batch.h`
- Generic weighting wrapper: `weighted_factor_batch.h`
- Dynamics (`dynamics/`): `SE2DifferentialDriveFactorBatch` (Carter: SE2 pose,
  wheel speeds, next pose) and `SE2KinematicBicycleFactorBatch` (car: pose, (v, δ),
  (a, δ̇), next pose, next (v, δ)), and their terrain versions
  `SE3DifferentialDriveFactorBatch` / `SE3KinematicBicycleFactorBatch` (SE3 pose;
  residual rows yaw, forward, lateral, vertical; roll/pitch left to terrain
  factors); `SE2/SO3/SE3KinematicsFactorBatch` (X_{k+1} = X_k Exp(dt ξ_k), the
  twist a vector state); `QuadrotorFactorBatch` (SE3 pose, velocity, rates, 4
  rotor thrusts; `QuadrotorParameters`) and `QuadrupedFactorBatch` (single rigid
  body, 4 foot forces, per-step contacts and foot positions;
  `QuadrupedParameters`): Euler multiple-shooting defect with
  per-factor time steps, analytic Jacobians; each kernel in its factor's own
  `.cu`, Lie operations from `cunls/math/lie_device.cuh`. Guide: `docs/sphinx/dynamics.rst`.
- IMU: `imu_factor_batch.h` (`ImuFactorBatch`, `ImuParameters`): keyframe pair
  (T_a, v_a, b_a, T_b, v_b, b_b), raw samples in a ragged CSR device array
  (7 floats each, `sample_offsets`); the intermediate states of the Euler chain
  are marginalized inside the factor every evaluation (covariance-form Riccati
  sweep; chains split over 1-32 lanes as composable summaries, sized from
  `num_samples / capacity`), residual 15 = whitened keyframe-b defect (9) +
  bias random walk (6). Guide: `docs/sphinx/imu.rst`; design:
  `docs/design/imu_schur_complement_factor.md`.
- Constraints (augmented Lagrangian, solved by `AugmentedLagrangianMinimizer`):
  `constraint_factor_batch.h` (`ConstraintKind`, `ConstraintFactorBatchBase`:
  multipliers per row and penalties per factor, AL residuals in `Evaluate`,
  raw values in `EvaluateConstraint`; `ConstraintFactorBatch`: non-owning
  wrapper turning any batch's rows into `s*r = 0` / `s*r <= 0`),
  `bound_factor_batch.h` (`BoundFactorBatch<Dim>`: box bounds on a vector
  state, itself an inequality batch), `halfspace_factor_batch.h`
  (`HalfspaceFactorBatch<Dim>`: `a^T x - b`, to be wrapped)

## Data contracts

- Inputs are typically device pointers and must remain valid for factor lifetime.
- Constructed with a capacity (measurements the buffers hold), fixed for the
  batch's lifetime. The active count `NumActiveFactors()` starts at 0:
  `SetNumActiveFactors(n)` (host-only) must be called before the first solve and may
  change it between solves up to `Capacity()`. Custom factors pass the
  capacity to `SizedFactorBatch(capacity)` instead of overriding
  `NumActiveFactors()`; wrappers forward the size calls to the wrapped batch.
- `Evaluate()` writes residuals and optionally Jacobians in contiguous batched
  layouts documented in each header.
- `state_pointers` is a flattened pointer array, grouped per factor.
- `Evaluate(residuals, jacobians, state_pointers, stream, factor_ids = nullptr,
  num_factor_ids = 0)` evaluates n items (n = num_factor_ids, or NumActiveFactors()
  when 0): item t is factor `factor_ids[t]` (or t % NumActiveFactors()) with its own
  pointer row `state_pointers[t * B ..]`; outputs are item-major. Results must
  match a plain evaluation bitwise. All built-in factors implement it (device
  helper `FactorMeasurementIndex` in `indexed_evaluation.cuh`); RANSAC relies
  on it.

## Related modules

- States consumed from `state/`.
- Optional robustification through `robustifier/` via `ResidualBatch`.
